project: STOCKHOLM — Founder City VI (GTA-Style AAA Open-World Vertical Slice)
art_direction: Grand Theft Auto VI illustrated loading-screen / stylized AAA realism hybrid: bold ink outlines, cel-shaded shadows, vibrant sunset/neon contrast, grounded Stockholm & San Francisco urban architecture.
engine_target: Unreal Engine 5.4+ (Lumen + Nanite + Post-Process Cel/Outline Shader)
